Elaine — for the kickoff we'll plan to share a working schema and an example of a streaming session. If you have a small sample payload (1–2 typical events), please attach to your invite.

Attachments: streamflow_enablement_schema_v1.json (draft), mutual_action_plan_SF-1291.xlsx, network_requirements_streamflow.pdf

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@streamflow.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + kickoff options for StreamFlow integration

Thanks — reviewed the draft schema and sketched a few items inline. High level notes:

- Schema strictness: We'll deliver a required-minimum schema for kickoff (fields with required: [event_type, timestamp, payload]) and a recommended extension set for later. For streaming, we will accept incremental objects as newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) during the session.

- Example mapping (row-oriented table in plain text):
  * Redwood function: call_emit_event(event) -> StreamFlow event_type mapping: 'transcription', 'action', 'metadata'
  * Structured output: top-level JSON envelope with fields: event_type (string), timestamp (RFC3339), payload (object), schema_version (string)

Inline sample (minimal, for discussion):
{
  "event_type": "action",
  "timestamp": "2026-06-29T17:00:00Z",
  "payload": {"action_id": "af3d1","confidence": 0.92},
  "schema_version": "v1"
}

- Function calling: we'll send function call metadata as a separate header in the stream and execute a single function per call to reduce ambiguity. We'll discuss error handling (retries vs. partial failure) at kickoff.

Connor — can you confirm that Redwood's streaming connections support TLS 1.2+ and client IP allowlist? If so, I'll add recommended firewall entries to the network checklist.

Thanks — I'll be on the kickoff and will own the post-kickoff implementation plan.

—Monica
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
